specification.title: Geolocation is contextual and never material support
specification.description: City/country geolocation is contextual-only and must never support a material verdict; with nothing else the acceptable envelope is INCONCLUSIVE and the approximation must be stated as a limitation.
specification.purpose: Verify city/country geolocation appears only as contextual support, contributes no material maliciousness evidence, and is surfaced as an approximation limitation.
specification.operational_relevance: Geolocation data is approximate and provider-derived; investigations must not let a city or country label drive a maliciousness verdict.
specification.regression_risk: The analyst could promote geolocation context into a material finding or omit the required approximation limitation.

required: The Assessment verdict is INCONCLUSIVE when the only context is geolocation
The Assessment states the approximate-geolocation limitation
forbidden: No material finding cites the geolocation context evidence
The Assessment reaches a verdict beyond the inconclusive envelope

fixture.objective: Assess whether the target IP is malicious based on its geolocation.

required_limitations: IP geolocation is approximate and does not establish maliciousness.
